title: Better music disc than before!
description: A simple music‑disc resource pack that replaces Cat, Blocks, and Chirp with custom Spotify‑style tracks, including Aria Math – Double Bass & Violin Cover, Breeze, and Echo in the Wind (Monolism Remix).
body:
This resource pack replaces three classic Minecraft music discs with custom high‑quality tracks inspired by a clean Spotify‑style playlist.

Replaced discs:
Cat → Aria Math – Double Bass & Violin Cover
Blocks → Breeze
Chirp → Echo in the Wind (Monolism Remix)

Each track is converted and balanced so it sounds natural in‑game while keeping the original disc behavior.

Features:

* High‑quality audio replacements

* Works on any version that supports resource packs

* No mods required

* Great for survival worlds, servers, or personal playlists

Installation:
Place the zip file in your resourcepacks folder and enable it in Minecraft.

All songs are found down below here!
